examples.english: And he said to him, I am now come, the chief captain of the host of the Lord.

examples.english: because of your burning incense, and because of the things wherein ye sinned against the Lord: and ye have not hearkened to the voice of the Lord, and have not walked in his ordinances, and in his law, and in his testimonies; and so these evils have come upon you.
